name: WHO SMART Skills
description: Specification-bound skills: conformance checks answerable to a normative specification WHO does not own, rather than to a WHO standard operating procedure. They know nothing about DAKs and are reusable outside SMART Guidelines.
rationale: Vendoring these into the starter kit would copy a versioned conformance rule into every downstream Implementation Guide and update it in none of them. The same reason smart-base sits in the substrate layer: referenced, never forked.

skills.name: Validate BPMN against the OMG specification
Validate DMN against the OMG specification
Validate FHIR resources against declared profiles
skills.specification: HL7 FHIR R4 / HL7 FHIR Validator

skills.name: Compare an IG Publisher qa.json against a baseline
Validate a knowledge graph against its ontology
